- Fixed driver options being cut off in small windows when an iGPU is present. The driver panel now scrolls so every button remains reachable.
- Driver update notifications now appear once per Windows boot. The checker keeps checking at your chosen interval until it finds an update; signing out and back in does not repeat the notification.
- Startup update checks now run at sign-in so notifications can appear on your desktop. Updating an existing checker preserves your check-on-boot preference.
- Reduced repeated package preparation and driver staging. GPU and iGPU installations reuse shared packages, completed extractions are reused when the download cache is retained, and the window stays responsive during display driver installation.
- Added elapsed times to installation logs to help identify slow steps.
- Fixed AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition installation to use AMD's bundled component installer.
- Corrected the installed video driver status when Windows is using its basic display driver, avoiding stale AMD version information.
- Removed a misleading warning during driver removal.
